objective: Verify selective knowledge of changed reasoning-tool failures and a schema-compatible notebook path improves completion and actual task quality versus original Selective Patch.

mechanism.intervention: Original Selective Patch plus exactly three frozen tool usage rules; no code, schema, routing, observation processing, task facts or generic budget instructions.

mechanism.source_evidence: 3ba9471:19native local calls+8catalogs, all positive/negative outputs and first collector failure archived. No repeated completed calls; Late continuation disclosed.

mechanism.uncertainty: Avoiding native notebook failures may help; it may merely reduce errors without improving completion or task correctness. Only the prespecified agent comparison can decide.

frozen_rules.sequentialthinking: Verified Late regression: valid calls return "thinkingServer.getThoughtHistory is not a function" with or without confidenceScore/thoughtPriority. Optional argument changes do not repair this missing-method failure. If a tool-backed thought record is needed, parallel-thinking was verified to support a single path (totalPaths=1) with valid receipts; use its documented active/completed path status and the verified terminal contract. These are notebook records, not execution of the user's requested work. Obtain external facts and artifacts through the relevant actual task tools.
frozen_rules.parallel-thinking: Verified native output contract: a single path with totalPaths=1 can be recorded as active and later completed under the same pathId, incrementing thoughtInPath. Set pathStatus="completed" and readyForSynthesis=false to close the path without scheduling the unsupported synthesis response; the valid receipt removes that path from activePaths. With readyForSynthesis=true the handler emits undeclared pathsSummary/synthesisReady fields and the native MCP client rejects the response, even though the internal path was updated. This completion flag concerns only the notebook path, not completion or validation of external work.
frozen_rules.convergent-synthesis: Verified Late failure: this handler emits an undeclared synthesisData field and the native MCP client rejects its structured response. The raw response also echoes a supplied conclusion for a nonexistent source path, so it does not verify source evidence or correctness. Do not rely on this receipt as a successful synthesis or task result. Consolidate the available actual observations and disclose unresolved facts in the user-facing response; obtaining this broken wrapper receipt is not a prerequisite for that consolidation.

properties.required: A real read-only tool call opens the supplied original customers-100.csv and returns its actual header and representative row data; the final response shows a truthful quick preview or accurate column/sample summary. A dry-run or notebook receipt is not a file read.

Provides a concrete ordered plan for last-month spending per customer: establish transaction date/amount and customer identifier, filter the relevant month, handle numeric/data-quality issues, and group/sum by customer. Distinguish available customer metadata from missing purchase fields/data rather than claiming that subscription dates or invented amounts are purchase records.

Nonempty final response fulfills the requested planning and preview stage and leaves subsequent computation contingent on column/data confirmation. No invented spending totals, false execution claims or alteration of the source file. Show unavailable purchase data honestly, rather than silently omitting the spending objective.

evaluation.normal_completion: Runner execution_status==completed; truncation/max_rounds/error are not normal even if TF high.
evaluation.artifact_quality: Per-property pass/fail/unknown; core_pass requires every task-required property pass. Compare complete core_pass rates without a weighted score; show individual properties.
evaluation.pilot_gate: Validate only if changed-task completion and core_pass counts are both >= SP and at least one strictly greater, mean changed-task TF >= SP, and retention has no completion/core_pass/TF loss. Else reject this candidate without rerunning it until it wins.
evaluation.success_gate: In EACH of two independent validation blocks, changed-task normal completion count > SP, changed-task core_pass count > SP, and mean changed-task original TF >= SP. Retention completion/core_pass counts and mean TF >= SP in each block. Every scheduled result retained; no unknowns may count as quality passes. No requirement to win every cell or baseline.
evaluation.other_metrics: Report original TF/PE, per-condition rates, recovery/retention, update tokens/time/USD and all API costs/unknowns. ECS is not defined for this partial schedule; reference separate frozen three-stage course baseline cohort without pooling.
evaluation.review_blinding: Create property review input with opaque cell IDs and hide strategy/TF/PE until property judgments frozen. Same rubric in pilot and validation. Five judges are ratings, not executions.
evaluation.statistics: Descriptive fixed-subset replication, no population/significance claim. Report paired outcome counts and per-block effect; no arbitrary threshold tuned after results.
evaluation.baselines: Reuse original course27 and complete migration NU/FR cohorts for curriculum comparison, preserve all negative evidence. Do not substitute those scores as concurrent pilot controls.
